title: Kaya's Weekend Memories
sentences: Kaya sat by the window on a quiet Sunday in November.
First, she looked at a picture from her trip to Japan last August.
Next, she opened her purple textbook because her homework was difficult.
After that, a woman on the TV said "Hello" to the viewers.
Kaya heard a song on the radio and felt very happy.
Then, she checked her watch and waited for her friend on Thursday.
"Hi, are you ready for our bike ride?" she asked on Wednesday.
Finally, she took the bus to the park on a sunny Saturday.
She loved the beautiful autumn leaves in the park in January.
Kaya said, "Please stay with me and enjoy the day."
